messages:
maria: Quick sweep — final tagging window in ~2h. I want an annotated tag + draft release ready before we upload artifacts. Ownership check: docker image, linux wheel, mac wheel, checksums. Reply with ✅ when you can take uploads.

tom: ✅ I can take docker + linux wheel. Will start uploads at T+30m.

anika: I can own mac wheel and the changelog blurb. @maria who triggers the annotated tag? CI or manual?

maria: CI tag workflow handles GPG signing (we use infra key). I'll trigger the workflow but will only push the annotated tag after we confirm artifacts are staged. Planned tag: v2.14.0-rc1.

chris: small reminder: add a short note about the runtime change in the release notes — affects cold-start latency. @anika pls include.

maria: plan: 
1) create annotated tag (v2.14.0-rc1) 
2) create draft release with prerelease=true 
3) upload artifacts + checksums 
4) smoke tests for 30m 
5) promote draft -> publish annotated release (if smoke green)

maria: command I'll run locally (but CI can do it too):
```bash
git tag -a v2.14.0-rc1 -m "v2.14.0-rc1"
git push origin v2.14.0-rc1
```

tom: uploading to staging now: https://staging-artifacts.internal/redwood/release/v2.14.0-rc1 — putting checksums at checksums/sha256sums.txt

infra-bot: deploy-bot: release-tag workflow queued (run id: 4578)

li: I'll validate checksums once uploads finish. Will report mismatches asap.

anika: just pushed changelog PR (link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1012) — includes the runtime note and docs snippet.

maria: good. Reminder: when creating GH draft release, set prerelease=true and add the link to the release tracking sheet. Also include artifact checksums in the body.

tom: uploading docker and linux wheel done. Using `gh release upload --clobber --retry 5` to avoid transient 403s.

chris: infra note — avoid uploading all artifacts in parallel; GH API can hit rate limits. Stagger by ~10s per asset.

anika: LGTM on changelog, added docs anchor.

infra-bot: release-tag workflow succeeded (run id: 4578) — annotated tag v2.14.0-rc1 created.

maria: Tag exists. I'll trigger the release:prepare action to create the draft. 

maria: creating draft release now and populating body with checklist and checksums.

devops: FYI — remember to add S3 lifecycle entry for /releases/v2.14.0-rc1 in case we need rollbacks. Sheet: https://docs.internal/releases/trackersheet

li: checksums validated: all good. Signed checksums uploaded.

chris: docs site needs an rc note; will stage docs redirect to /docs/rc/v2.14.0-rc1.

maria: smoke tests running (smoke-runner job id: 9923). Waiting 30m. If any failing test is non-blocking (minor telemetry), we still proceed, but will call it out in the release notes.

tom: small snag: Mac wheel build failed on a flaky test. Rebuilding and will reupload when green. ETA 12m.

anika: thanks — I'll note that as a known issue in the draft release notes.

maria: smoke green at T+28m. Releasing in 5. If folks still have last-minute edits, now's the time.

maria: publishing annotated release...

infra-bot: release:publish action started (run id: 4599)

devops: added milestone, updated trackersheet.

infra-bot: release:publish action succeeded — release v2.14.0-rc1 is public (draft -> published).

maria: published. :tada: Thanks team. Follow-ups: update canary routes in platform, and schedule patch-cherry-pick window for any hotfixes.

chris: noted. I'll open the canary PR and assign ops.

anika: will stitch docs redirects and add a short 'what's new' blurb.

li: will kick off regression suite overnight and report any regressions in #incidents if found.

maria: Great. If anything unexpected pops up, start a thread in #incidents and ping me. Otherwise, nice job shipping the RC. :white_check_mark:
